description: This file contains functions for processing and deserializing web configuration data related to WAN interfaces, markings, and failover parameters, utilizing msgpack serialization.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WaneMgr_WebConfig_Process_MarkingEntry(WebConfig_Wan_Marking_Table_t * e,msgpack_object_map * map)
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_Wan_Marking_Table_t structure, extracting alias and Ethernet priority mark values.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_ifParams(WebConfig_Wan_Interface_Table_t * e,msgpack_object_map * map)
methods.description: Processes a msgpack map to populate WebConfig_Wan_Interface_Table_t, including its marking table.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_WanFailOver_Params(msgpack_object obj,WanMgr_WebConfig_t * pWebConfig)
methods.description: Deserializes WAN failover parameters from a msgpack object and populates WebConfig_Wan_FailOverData_t.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_Wanmanager_Params(msgpack_object obj,WanMgr_WebConfig_t * pWebConfig)
methods.description: Deserializes the top-level WAN manager web configuration, including interface configurations, from a msgpack object.
